JPEG 转换：全部可用目标JPEG conversions: every available target

JPEG 在拍摄那一刻就丢掉了透明与一部分高频细节，之后的每条路线只能决定要不要再丢一次。转 PNG 或 WebP 不会恢复细节；写进 PDF 会按图片自身尺寸建页，不套 A4。若需要图里的文字，唯一诚实的答案是先做 OCR。A JPEG already gave up transparency and some high-frequency detail when it was captured; every route from here only decides whether to lose more. Converting to PNG or WebP does not restore detail, and writing to PDF builds a page at the image’s own size rather than A4. If the words inside matter, the honest answer is OCR first.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 没有 OCR，也没有文字层；JPEG 里的文字只是像素No OCR and no text layer; words in a JPEG are pixels
  • 图片源格式到 TXT、CSV、JSON、Excel 的组合被 conversion-policy 置灰并说明原因Image sources to TXT, CSV, JSON and Excel are greyed out by conversion-policy, with the reason shown
  • 转 PNG 是无损容器装已有像素，不会提高清晰度；源文件的大小编码损失无法撤销PNG is a lossless container for pixels that already exist, not a sharpness upgrade; the source’s encoding loss cannot be undone
  • 超大图按 MAX_DIM 缩放，转 PDF 时页面尺寸也随之缩小Very large images scale to MAX_DIM, and the PDF page size shrinks with them

常见问题Questions people actually ask

JPEG 转 PNG 会变清晰吗？Does JPEG to PNG become sharper?

不会。转换只是把已有像素放进无损容器，压缩造成的块效应与模糊已经写在像素里。要提升清晰度需要原始未压缩图像或超分辨率工具。No. The conversion puts existing pixels into a lossless container; the blocking and blur from compression are already in those pixels. A sharper result needs the original uncompressed image or a super-resolution tool.

JPEG 转 WebP 值得吗？Is JPEG to WebP worth it?

通常能减小体积，但这是一次再编码，细节会再损失一点。若原图是高质量 JPEG 且要长期保存，转 PNG 做无损封装更稳；若目标是网页加载，WebP 的体积优势更实际。It usually saves bytes, but it is a re-encode and gives up a little more detail. For a high-quality JPEG kept long term, wrapping the pixels in PNG is safer; for web delivery, WebP’s size advantage is the practical win.

JPEG 转 PDF 是 A4 吗？Is a JPEG to PDF page A4?

不是。页面按图片自身的宽高与像素建（96 DPI 换算成点），横图得到横向页面、竖图得到纵向页面；整张图铺满一页。No. The page is built from the image’s own dimensions and pixels at 96 DPI: a landscape image gets a landscape page and a portrait one a portrait page, with the picture filling it.

能把多张 JPEG 分别转成 PDF 吗？Can several JPEGs each become a PDF?

能。同一批次里每个文件各出一份 PDF，整批共用一个目标格式；需要一次下载就打 ZIP。当前版本不会把多张图合并成一份 PDF。Yes. Each file in the batch produces its own PDF under one shared target, and a ZIP collects them in one download. This version does not merge several images into a single PDF.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
